title: Permissions and search path
question: The table exists, but the app gets a permission error or cannot see it. Which role is the app really using, and what is it allowed to do?
exercises: PostgreSQL permissions and which role an app really uses

controls.purpose: A different role runs the same query and gets the same 42501, so the error alone does not show which role the application used.
A role without USAGE on the schema gets 42P01 without the schema name, as if the table were missing, and is refused at the schema with it.
A role whose search path leaves out the schema also gets 42P01 without the schema name, but the schema-qualified query works.
After the one-table grant, the different role is still refused, so the grant reached only the intended role.

competingExplanations: The application connects as a different role
The role has no USAGE on the schema
The search path leaves out the schema
Row-level security, column privileges or access inherited through another role
The customer environment differs from this lab
stillToBuild: Roles that inherit access through group roles
